title: 雨夜咖啡馆的时间循环

storyBible.worldAnchor: Cozy, rain-soaked café in a small town, warm lamplight, nostalgic ambience, subtle camera focus on intimate moments.

characters.name: Lee
characters.anchorPrompt: Lee, a young adult wearing a dark jacket and coat, standing upright with a neutral expression, holding a coffee cup

props.name: Coffee Cup
props.anchorPrompt: small white ceramic coffee cup with a blue rim, placed on a wooden table, steam gently rising

props.anchorPrompt: folded dark blue umbrella hanging on a hook beside the window, wooden handle, fabric panels

locations.name: Rainy Night Café
locations.anchorPrompt: cozy indoor café with wooden tables, low lamps, faded wallpaper, a window showing rain, chalkboard menu, mid-20th century style

eventChain: Protagonist sits at the rain-soaked café, realizing tonight’s choice will change everyone’s fate.
Protagonist confronts a decision: investigate the anomaly or protect a companion.
If investigating, the protagonist follows clues and uncovers a repeating pattern.
If protecting, the protagonist shields a companion, missing a clue but gaining deeper trust.
The protagonist breaks the time loop and walks into a new morning holding the truth.
The protagonist keeps the secret, leaving the world unchanged while knowing the next choice.
